A0148.title: ICS Security Monitoring and Incident Response
A0148.definition: Real-time monitoring of industrial control system operational status, with an established incident response mechanism for rapid security event handling.
A0148.description: Monitoring system: IDS/IPS dedicated to industrial control traffic; SIEM integrates security events; baseline behavior modeling; anomaly alerts; emergency response drills; backup systems.
A0148.limitation: Industrial control protocols are proprietary and fragmented, making it difficult for IDS/IPS rules to achieve full coverage; novel attack commands can bypass signature matching, leading to missed detections. Normal process tuning and device start/stop operations are easily confused with attack behavior, resulting in a high false positive rate. Emergency response actions (e.g., network disconnection, system shutdown) may impact production continuity, and there is also a risk of mistakenly blocking normal operational commands. There is a shortage of specialized industrial control security professionals; baseline modeling and alert triage rely heavily on experience, and rules lag behind emerging threats.
keywords: ICS Security Monitoring and Incident Response
